name: vibe-coding-assistant
description: AI coding assistant with file editing tools

vibe-coding.models.description: List of model configurations for model switching. Each entry can override apiBaseUrl, apiKey, maxInteractions, and maxSequenceLength. Falls back to global vibe-coding.* settings when omitted.

name.description: Display name shown in the model selector dropdown

model.description: Model name to send to the API (e.g. gpt-4o, deepseek-chat)

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional base URL override for this model (falls back to vibe-coding.apiBaseUrl)

apiKey.description: Optional API key override for this model (falls back to vibe-coding.apiKey)

maxInteractions.description: Optional max tool call iterations override for this model (-1 = unlimited, falls back to vibe-coding.maxInteractions)

maxSequenceLength.description: Optional max context/sequence length override for this model in characters (falls back to vibe-coding.maxSequenceLength)

vibe-coding.confirmChanges.description: Whether to ask for confirmation before applying file changes (edit tool)

vibe-coding.confirmShellCommand.description: Whether to ask for confirmation before executing run_shell_command (after shell review); independent from confirmChanges

vibe-coding.maxInteractions.description: Maximum number of tool call iterations (-1 means unlimited)

vibe-coding.maxSequenceLength.description: Maximum length for generated text sequences

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect based on user's VS Code display language (English if UI is English, Chinese if UI is Chinese)
vibe-coding.language.description: Language for AI assistant interaction. Controls the language used in system prompts, tool descriptions, and assistant responses.

vibe-coding.todolistReview.enabled.description: When true, create_todo_list runs a blocking independent LLM review for todolist.generate / todolist.edit before applying changes.

vibe-coding.todolistReview.maxAttempts.description: Max review/regenerate rounds per create_todo_list call (generate or expand).

vibe-coding.todolistReview.reviewTimeout.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for each review-agent and regenerate (generate) API call.

vibe-coding.todolistReview.editorTimeout.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for each editor-agent API call (todolist.edit expand retries).

vibe-coding.editReview.enabled.description: When true, code edit tool calls run a blocking independent LLM review (separate from the main assistant) before applying changes.

vibe-coding.editReview.timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for the independent review call used by the code edit tool.

vibe-coding.shellCommandReview.enabled.description: When true, run_shell_command runs an independent safety review before optional human confirmation (single-pass, same mode as code edit review).

vibe-coding.shellCommandReview.reviewTim.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for the shell safety review API call.

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').mkdirSync('out')"
